id: title:EDsCODE:wait out v3 full refresh delta rebuild in ducklake copy

observations.behavior: Adds a retry loop that catches transient 'Delta table absent' errors and sleeps before re-attempting.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent copy-import workflows from failing immediately when the warehouse loader is rebuilding tables during v3 full-refresh syncs.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct staging calls with the new waiting wrapper for Duckgres-based imports.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes execution behavior of existing import paths to tolerate temporary unavailability without propagating false failures.

observations.behavior: Tests verify the function retries twice, then raises or succeeds; also tests immediate failure on unrelated errors and timeout after wait budget.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression checks against both expected recovery and incorrect suppression of real failures.

observations.limitations: Only P1 chunk provided. No broader context on how this integrates into other workflow dependencies or end-to-end reliability guarantees.

review.limitations: Only P1 chunk provided. No broader context on how this integrates into other workflow dependencies or end-to-end reliability guarantees.
review.reason: The change adds bounded, localized resilience around a specific transient condition (warehouse rebuild) with clear implementation and matching unit tests. It does not demonstrate systemic risk reduction across multiple components.
review.posthog_relevance: Could reduce unnecessary copy-import failures in warehouse ingestion pipelines by distinguishing transient absence from permanent errors.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on P1 chunk; no wider dependency analysis available.
